nodes.label: Shallow PARA with typed wiki
nodes.summary: Because the vault already retired top-level Projects/Areas/Resources/Archives folders, PARA is recommended as a tag-based classification layer over the existing wiki/sources, wiki/concepts, wiki/entities and wiki/resources schema, never as a return to physical PARA folders.

nodes.label: Satset as immutable source mirror
nodes.summary: Final recommendation: keep Satset/ as an immutable source mirror and build the wiki-centric PARA overlay from sanitized, classified derived pages instead of moving or renaming any original file.

nodes.label: satset_id as application identity and sync protocol
nodes.norm_label: satset_id as application identity and sync protocol
nodes.summary: All 522 Satset files carry a UUID satset_id, and the documented sync implementation scans it, preserves it during conflict handling, strips it from conflict copies and avoids duplicate ID indexing. It is identity, not metadata.

nodes.label: Copilot mirror duplicates every Satset basename and satset_id
nodes.norm_label: copilot mirror duplicates every satset basename and satset_id
nodes.summary: /copilot/Satset holds 547 entries including all 522 Satset basenames plus about 25 variants, carrying 546 satset_id matches. Copying or moving Satset files without handling the mirror risks duplicate satset_id indexing, wrong conflict-copy selection and Copilot search resolving to the wrong file.

nodes.label: Filename-to-satset_id mapping discrepancy between canonical and mirror copies
nodes.norm_label: filename to satset_id mapping discrepancy between canonical and mirror copies
nodes.summary: For belajar-efektif-tidak-mudah.md and its -1 variant, the two satset_id values are associated with different filenames in Satset/ versus copilot/Satset/, which the audit classifies as a sync/index integrity issue rather than a naming issue, and the same check is prescribed for the other duplicate pairs.

nodes.label: Legacy title-style [[Satset/...]] links in Copilot index files
nodes.norm_label: legacy title-style [[satset/...]] links in copilot index files
nodes.summary: Copilot-Indexed-Files-* files carry large blocks of legacy references such as [[Satset/1. Mindset Bisnis.md]] using historical title-style names rather than current kebab-case filenames, so most are already stale and any rename or move would make more of them unresolved.

nodes.label: source_satset_id and source_path pointers on derived wiki pages
nodes.norm_label: source_satset_id and source_path pointers on derived wiki pages
nodes.summary: Phase 2 of the migration builds a mapping rather than a move: each derived wiki page carries source_satset_id and source_path so the page stays traceable to its origin even after renaming.

nodes.label: Credential rotation ordered by blast radius before any migration
nodes.norm_label: credential rotation ordered by blast radius before any migration
nodes.summary: Before any PARA migration, detected values are treated as potentially live and rotated in a stated order: Supabase service-role keys, private keys and certificates, provider API keys, n8n/Heroku API and JWT credentials, cookies and session tokens, recovery/2FA codes, then third-party integration tokens — with duplicate copies checked in copilot/, raw/, Git history and backups.

nodes.label: Every duplicate suffix variant pair needs a deliberate identity decision
nodes.norm_label: every duplicate suffix variant pair needs a deliberate identity decision
nodes.summary: Belajar-cepat-dengan-bcb-academy/-1, visual-design-guidelines/-1/-2, untitled-note-1..5, decryption-failed-*, infografis-bca/-1, one-piece-philosophy/-1 and vegapunk/-1 collide after kebab-case conversion, so deduplication requires an explicit per-pair identity decision rather than automatic renaming.

nodes.label: Satset protection is repository policy, not a per-file frontmatter flag
nodes.norm_label: satset protection is repository policy not a per-file frontmatter flag
nodes.summary: No reliable protected: true or locked: true field exists anywhere in the collection; protection comes from the README rule not to move, rename or modify Satset files, so it must be enforced by the migration process itself. Frontmatter is also non-uniform: some notes lack tags, some close the block early, and body-level --- separators inside HTML exports would confuse a naive parser.

nodes.label: The old protection policy must be consciously overridden, not silently ignored
nodes.norm_label: the old protection policy must be consciously overridden not silently ignored
nodes.summary: The current request asks for PARA planning, so the README rule protecting Satset is treated as a repository-level safety constraint that must be consciously overridden and documented, rather than quietly disregarded.

nodes.label: Service-role keys are rotated first because they bypass user-level restrictions
nodes.norm_label: service-role keys are rotated first because they bypass user-level restrictions
nodes.summary: Service-role keys are called out as especially urgent precisely because they bypass the normal user-level restrictions that would otherwise limit the blast radius of a leaked key.

nodes.label: satset_id is identity rather than metadata, so copying it must not mint new IDs
nodes.norm_label: satset_id is identity rather than metadata so copying it must not mint new ids
nodes.summary: The sync implementation scans satset_id, preserves it across conflict handling, strips it from conflict files and avoids duplicate ID indexing, which makes the field part of the application's identity model and not something a derived page should regenerate.

nodes.label: Preserve the old Satset path so legacy Copilot consumers stay resolvable
nodes.norm_label: preserve the old satset path so legacy copilot consumers stay resolvable
nodes.summary: The prescribed safeguard is to leave the Copilot mirror untouched and keep the original Satset path until every consumer of the legacy [[Satset/...]] links has been inventoried, because those references already use historical filenames and a rename would only add unresolved links.
